title: Seoul overpass safety questioned after another severed tendon is discovered
caption:
A critical steel cable snapped inside Seoul's Jeongneungcheon Overpass shortly after it received a satisfactory safety grade. City officials acknowledged standard inspections do not look inside the concrete, prompting plans to replace 35 internal tendons.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul overpass safety questioned after another severed tendon is discovered
